meta.note: Irregularities and unverified items. Per the owner's instruction these do not block the merge; they are published here with source links for review. Verified as of 2026-11-20.

flags.item: Repo contained no COORDINATION.md and no task board
flags.irregularity: The brief asks for a shared board and session branches named session-<id>/<task>. The session rules for this run require a single working branch (arena/e2aacbd6-demo3). The board was created here on that single branch.

flags.item: README.md is a single line ('# Demo3'); no license, no build tooling, no existing site
flags.irregularity: No license file is present, so reuse terms are unspecified. GitHub Pages was already enabled on the repo, built from main / (legacy build). Changing the source to /docs returned 403 for this session (admin needed), so the Pages source was NOT changed. The tracker is served under docs/tracker/ from the existing root source.

flags.item: All three Poland Sejm markets carry a placeholder strike value
flags.irregularity: custom_strike is {"demo strike": "demo strike"} on KXPOLANDSEJM-27-THIRD, -PIS and -LEFT. It is not a real strike; it looks like a demo placeholder left in the data.

flags.item: '100 DOGE' perpetual-style product listed in the Crypto event-contract series list
flags.irregularity: contract_url is empty, tags and settlement_sources are null, frequency is 'often', and contract_terms_url is malformed (https://assets.kalshi.com/contract_terms/.pdf). Kalshi's docs describe perpetual futures as a separate product with its own API (Perps APIs at docs.kalshi.com/margin). It is not verified whether this series is a perp.

flags.item: Settlement-source publisher names do not match their URLs
flags.irregularity: Examples in the returned data: 'Etherscan' linked to counterparty.io; 'The Block', 'Arbiscan', 'Decrypt', 'DeFi Llama', 'Base Explorer', 'Solscan' and 'project' each linked to kalshi.com. Both airdrop series also point to the same AIRDROP.pdf terms file.

flags.item: Bitcoin market lists a DOT index as its settlement source
flags.irregularity: The settlement source URL is cfbenchmarks.com/data/indices/DOTUSD_RTI (a DOT index) for a market titled 'Will BTC fall below 75k before hitting 100k?'.

flags.item: Topic placement is unclear
flags.irregularity: A series titled 'Sushila Karki leave office' is in the Elections category, tagged 'International'. Whether it belongs under Elections is a judgment call. It is listed here under Elections for the dashboard and flagged for confirmation.

flags.item: Settlement-source lists include unrelated or non-official links
flags.irregularity: Both series share one list that includes a Barchart page for $INX, the U.S. Energy Information Administration, and several google.com/search?q= links (e.g. 'account holder of', Ars Technica, Engadget, Mashable, Verge). These are not official primary sources for an X ban.

flags.item: Last traded price before settlement differs from result
flags.irregularity: HOUSEAKAL-26-D had last_price 0.99 and resolved 'no' (settlement value 0.0000). Kalshi's settlement doc says a YES holder receives $1 per contract on a yes outcome and a NO holder receives $1 on a no outcome. The last traded price is therefore not the payout; this is consistent with the docs, but the dashboard must not treat last price as a result.
flags.status: Verified against docs; flagged for awareness

flags.item: Stale quotes with no bid
flags.irregularity: The three open Ryder Cup markets were last updated 2026-04-28 and show yes_bid 0.00 with yes_ask 1.00. The 0.90 last price on the Team USA market is therefore stale.

flags.item: No liquidity on the open head-to-head markets
flags.irregularity: volume 0.00 and open interest 0.00 on all three. Two show yes_bid 0.01 against yes_ask 1.00. Tyler Duncan vs Mac Meissner shows bid 0.00 and ask 0.00 (no quotes).

flags.item: Mutually exclusive outcomes do not sum to a coherent price
flags.irregularity: Last prices: 0.04 + 0.98 + 0.04 = 1.06. Yes bids: 0.02 + 0.02 + 0.02 = 0.06. Yes asks: 0.97 + 0.99 + 0.97 = 2.93. The orderbook for PIS shows only one NO bid (0.01) and two YES bid levels. Liquidity is thin, so prices are not a reliable probability read.

flags.item: Kalshi reports contract counts, not dollars
flags.irregularity: The brief asks for the highest dollar amount. The API reports volume_fp as a count of contracts. No dollar-volume field was found in the responses checked, so the dashboard ranks by contracts. Any dollar figure would be an inference, which the brief rules out.

flags.item: Demo prices may not reflect real markets
flags.irregularity: Kalshi's demo docs say 'The price and behavior of markets in the demo environment may not be reflective of those in real markets.' Every number in this site is demo data with mock funds.

flags.item: Gasoline series not found; diesel has no markets
flags.irregularity: tags=Gas returned only DIESEL (weekly) and DIESELM (monthly), both with 0.00 volume. A market-list query for DIESEL (no filter) returned no markets, so no gas market is live on the demo API. A gasoline series was not located.

flags.item: Browser access (CORS) and rate limits not verified from the published site
flags.irregularity: The build sandbox cannot reach external-api.demo.kalshi.co (SSL error from the shell), so the live dashboard's cross-origin calls from GitHub Pages could not be tested. The dashboard falls back to the verified snapshot if they fail. Rate-limit tiers were not checked.

flags.item: Seconds-level price history is not available via REST candlesticks
flags.irregularity: Candlestick period_interval is limited to 1, 60 or 1440 minutes (docs). A seconds view would need the WebSocket API, which is not implemented here.

flags.item: The snapshot covers only the first chunk of each category list
flags.irregularity: Golf (27 chunks), Crypto (36) and Elections (529) series lists were not paged in full. Series in the snapshot are a partial list. Culture (2 series) and Gas (2 series) were complete.

flags.item: No trades were executed and no portfolio data was pulled
flags.irregularity: Portfolio, order placement and fills endpoints need a signed API key pair (KALSHI-ACCESS-KEY/-SIGNATURE/-TIMESTAMP). Keys are created by a logged-in demo account. This session has no credentials and was not given any, so the trade-execution and performance parts of the brief are blocked. No credentials were requested or stored.
flags.status: Blocked: needs a demo API key (see Q-01)

flags.item: Demo API CORS verified live
flags.irregularity: GET /exchange/status returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin: https://karagemop466-tech.github.io; browser direct fetch allowed. Recorded every run in data/cors_test.json.

flags.item: Seeded volumes, MVE market flood, no live gas/golf at collection time
flags.irregularity: (a) Demo-seeded volumes are very large (top election event est. ~$900M - demo money, not real). (b) Synthetic cross-category MVE events flood /markets?status=open newest-first (9,000 newest markets covered only 445 events), breaking naive pagination - collector uses nested-events pagination instead. (c) No live gas/golf events at 2026-11-20 collection time - their topics show resolution history only.

flags.item: Demo-account credentials absent - pipeline unverified live
flags.irregularity: Signed trading/portfolio pipeline implemented and offline-tested (11 tests incl. Ed25519 signature verification) but no demo credentials exist in this environment; no portfolio/trade rows produced and none inferred. Site shows awaiting-credentials states.

flags.item: Sub-minute granularity unavailable via REST
flags.irregularity: Candlesticks support 1/60/1440-minute intervals only; seconds-level views would need the demo WebSocket feed (browser handshake unverified). No seconds data shown rather than faked.

flags.item: Non-official docs domain corrected
flags.irregularity: Pre-existing pages linked docs.kalshi.io (not Kalshi's official documentation domain); replaced with docs.kalshi.com during integration.
